name: Aloe vera
uses: Topically used to treat minor burns, cuts, and moisturize skin. May ease skin irritation.
notes: Avoid ingesting large amounts; for topical use only.

name: Ginger (Zingiber officinale)
uses: Helps with nausea and motion sickness and can reduce mild inflammation. Often used as tea.
notes: May interact with blood-thinning medication in large amounts.

name: Neem (Azadirachta indica)
uses: Used in topical preparations for skin conditions and as a traditional antiseptic.
notes: Not recommended for internal use without professional guidance.
